metadata.principle: Closure -> CLR -> Helmert ILR -> trajectory tensor -> depth tower; deterministic compositional inference with embedded version triple.

tensor._description: Per-step compositional tensor: closure, CLR, ILR, kappa_HS_full (order-2), s_j_sensitivity (order-1), bearing pairs, and step-to-step angular velocity / helmsman local index. Schema v3.1.0 adds navigation_concentration_family per timestep (K_eff, TV distance, K_eff YoY, TV acceleration, concentration regime tag).

navigation_concentration_summary._description: Series-level summary of the navigation concentration family (K_eff + TV distance + regime tags). Promoted from runner-side packet_operators.py into the canonical engine at schema v3.1.0 (HUF MC-4 packet operators).

stage1._description: CLR-space pairwise (i, j) coordinate ranges across the trajectory.

stage2._description: Pairwise structure: variation matrix tau and per-pair correlations / bearing spread.

stage3._description: Triadic areas, subcomposition ladder, regime-boundary detection.

depth_tower._description: Depth-tower diagnostics: energy and curvature level trajectories, P2 attractor parameter fit, M^2=I metric involution sample, IR classification.
